Desktop: DeepSeek Harness starts on Windows; exports drawn again when the browser fails (#175)

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"@openfilm/desktop": patch
+---
+
+Windows: DeepSeek Harness installed with npm starts in the chat. The app's own Node now starts an agent's program as the main module, as Node would, so a program that runs only when it is the main one (DeepSeek Harness's `dsh`) no longer exits at once without a word.

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"openfilm": patch
+---
+
+Exports: a video whose browser crashed or stopped answering is drawn once more in a new one, as an editing project's pages already were. A page or a file the browser could not load for want of the system's network buffers (`net::ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE`, seen on Windows) is drawn again too, instead of failing the export.
